calculationBasis: Per-serving ingredient-sum estimate: sum(GI × available carbohydrate per serving)/100. Fineli Rel20 is the primary available-carbohydrate source; AFCD Release 3 fills only two missing Fineli foods (chickpea flour and tamarind paste). Published exact GI values, explicit analogues, and Table 1 category means may be used with source, match type, and confidence disclosed. Ingredients below 1 g available carbohydrate per serving are omitted. Not a measured mixed-meal response.
fineliEvidence: docs/nutrition/fineli-release-20-reference.json; only required records are copied into docs/nutrition/food-records.json. Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL), Fineli Rel20, CC BY 4.0.
massEvidence: Amounts are from structured Finnish recipe frontmatter. Grams use listed weights; other units use food-specific Fineli Rel20 MASS values. If only dl mass exists, rkl/tl are converted from food-specific density using 15/5 ml spoon volume and documented per ingredient.
excludedIngredientPolicy: Trace seasonings and unspecified salt are conservative documented assumptions, omitted only below 1 g available carbohydrate per serving. Unresolved substantial ingredients block totals.

selectionNotes.selectionBasis: New recipes were selected from the highest current recipe-level available-carbohydrate estimates outside the first cohort; every selected recipe is recalculated from its ingredient-level Fineli amounts.
replacements: Massaman curry is included as the 21st calculated estimate with a documented curry-paste carbohydrate scenario range; eggplant and minced-beef casserole remains in the cohort.
Beef liver casserole remains without a published GL total because the earlier 3.45 estimate used an unmeasured zero-GI assumption for liver carbohydrates.
selectionNotes.massamanAdded: Massaman was the 21st estimate when originally added. At the fifth-batch baseline, the pilot covers 121 recipes; 112 calculate and 9 remain incomplete.
selectionNotes.excludedPublication: Beef liver casserole remains without a published total: the prior 3.45 estimate assigned an unmeasured GI of zero to liver carbohydrates.
selectionNotes.newCohort: Twenty new recipes were chosen from the highest current available-carbohydrate estimates outside the existing 21. Selection rankings are not GK results; every estimate is recalculated from recipe ingredient amounts.
selectionNotes.ingredientSources: Fineli Rel20 remains the primary available-carbohydrate source. AFCD Release 3 supplies only chickpea flour and tamarind paste where Fineli had no matching item. Current batch also uses Semper Pofiber product label data (GTIN 7310100857200; manufacturer document) for potato fibre and uses the existing Fineli Rel20 #20 unsweetened cocoa record (11 g available carbohydrate/100 g); AFCD vanilla extract composition is used where the Fineli food list has no matching extract record.
selectionNotes.newBatch: Six further recipes were added because matching ingredient-level Fineli/AFCD calculation records were available. Fourteen other high-ranking candidates remain for later batches until ingredient mappings, masses and preparation details are checked. Existing recipe-level carbohydrate estimates were used only to rank candidates; each GL result is recalculated ingredient by ingredient.
selectionNotes.nextBatch: The next fourteen highest currently ranked recipes with ingredient calculation files are koshari, baozi, Moroccan couscous, pasta alla Norma, bulgogi, congee, tomato-egg stir-fry, harira, Greek moussaka, doner kebab, souvlaki, gazpacho, spanakopita and tabbouleh. Existing per-recipe available-carbohydrate values were used only for ranking; GI estimates are recalculated ingredient by ingredient. Missing material mappings or masses block publication.
selectionNotes.thirdBatch: Twenty next-highest recipe-level carbohydrate estimates with completed ingredient calculation records are added for GL review. The ranking values select the recipes only; GI calculations use ingredient amounts, Fineli/AFCD records and documented unit conversions. Missing material GI or mapping evidence blocks a total.
selectionNotes.fourthBatch: Twenty highest remaining recipe-level carbohydrate estimates without a completed ingredient calculation file are reviewed in this batch. Selection values are ranking evidence only. Two liver recipes remain without total GL because a justified GI value for liver is not available; the sweetened quark bowl remains incomplete because sweetener type and amount are unspecified. Other totals use ingredient-level Fineli/AFCD data and disclosed category proxies.
selectionNotes.fifthBatch: Twenty next-highest remaining recipe-level available-carbohydrate candidates were reviewed ingredient by ingredient. 13 received complete low-confidence ingredient-sum estimates and 7 remain incomplete; ranking values selected this batch only. Fineli Rel20 and AFCD Release 3 supply available carbohydrates. Product-specific Semper Pofiber label and Fineli #20 cocoa powder records resolved two ingredient-source gaps; the variable 150 g pizza topping choice, removed lemongrass retention, unspecified sweetener, and unmeasured garnish/pan-fat amounts still block totals. No partial GL is published.
selectionNotes.sixthBatch: Twenty new recipes were reviewed: the five highest remaining quantified recipe-level available-carbohydrate candidates plus 15 rice-, noodle-, flour- and legume-based dishes, prioritized by their structured major carbohydrate ingredients because most remaining repository recipes have no nutrient totals. Ranking selects candidates only; each GL is recalculated from source ingredients. Unsupported quantities, unlabelled sauces and recipe alternatives remain explicit blockers. Source-backed sunflower oil replaced unmeasured neutral-oil entries; broad sauce GI analogues remain explicitly low confidence. Audit result: 9 of these 20 have complete low-confidence estimates; 11 remain incomplete. The current cohort totals 121 calculated estimates and 20 incomplete records across 141 reviewed recipes.
selectionNotes.seventhBatch: The next batch reviews the 19 highest remaining quantified ingredient-level carbohydrate candidates in the current nutrition inventory plus pho bo, whose dry rice noodles provide a substantial measured starch portion. Existing nutrition totals rank candidates only; GL is recalculated from ingredient amounts and linked Fineli/AFCD values. Fourteen of the 20 recipes have complete low-confidence estimates; six remain incomplete because a material GI match, amount, or food mapping is unavailable. In particular, processed sausage GI and pho-bo stock/aromatic carbohydrate retention remain unresolved.
selectionNotes.eighthBatch: The 20 highest-priority remaining candidate recipes were reviewed from structured recipe ingredients: 11 reused current source-backed Fineli/AFCD calculation records and nine were audited from their current ingredient cards. Complete recipe totals are produced only when every material carbohydrate ingredient has a defensible mass, food record and GI match; otherwise the report names the blocker. Category means and analogues remain low-confidence estimates. Ranking selects candidates only and never supplies calculation values.

jerk-kana: 4 spring onions have no recipe-specific Fineli mass; the estimate cannot establish their available carbohydrate per serving.
tangyuan: The recipe lists 100 g black sesame without a matching Fineli record; the carbohydrate contribution and GI cannot be sourced.
paella-valenciana: Chicken stock uses a named product but no product-specific concentration is specified; stock GI is not directly matched, so a category-level soup proxy would be weak for this concentrated cooked dish.
rendang-padang: Coconut milk contributes >1 g available carbohydrate per serving and no valid GI record matches canned coconut milk; the available coconut-milk porridge value is not transferable.
malesialainen-apam-balik: The recipe says one corn without specifying fresh, cooked, or grilled state; Fineli cob mass can be looked up, but preparation and GI cannot be matched unambiguously.
malesialainen-kookos-banaanikulho: Palm sugar lacks a matching Fineli food record; tapioca flour has a carbohydrate record but no published GI matched to the recipe preparation.
meksikolainen-kurpitsapuuro-piloncilloll: Pumpkin is unweighed (Fineli medium whole pumpkin is only a possible scenario) and the recipe offers milk or water, changing carbohydrate totals.
indonesialainen-pisang-goreng-aamiaiseks: Coconut is listed without fresh/dried state, palm sugar lacks a matching Fineli record, and banana mass is unspecified.
nasi-lemak: The sambal is an unbranded prepared sauce with no ingredient composition or matching GI; coconut milk preparation also lacks a defensible GI match if its measured carbohydrate exceeds the per-serving cutoff.

selectionNotes.ninthBatch: Twenty highest remaining explicit starch/legume/sugar candidates were reviewed from current Finnish recipe ingredient metadata. The one existing ingredient calculation was reused and independently mapped to GI. Other recipes use Fineli Rel20 or AFCD Release 3 mappings where food state and portion are supportable; each unresolved substantial ingredient or unit is an explicit blocker. Recipe ranking selected candidates only; ranking values were not used in GK calculation. GI category means and closest published analogues are low-confidence estimates, not meal measurements.
selectionNotes.tenthBatch: Twenty remaining recipes were selected from current recipe cards for explicit starch, grain, legume and fruit sources. Recipe ingredient amounts were used only for per-recipe calculation. Ambiguous sauces, liquid options, unsupported food states and implausible quantities remain blockers rather than receiving partial totals.
selectionNotes.tenthBatchReview: Twenty recipes were audited from Finnish structured recipe cards. Seven have complete ingredient totals using Fineli/AFCD available-carbohydrate evidence and published GI category means or documented analogues; these remain low-confidence estimates. Thirteen are withheld because at least one material food, preparation, unit mass, sauce or recipe choice is unresolved. No partial totals are published.
selectionNotes.eleventhBatch: Twenty remaining recipes were selected from Finnish recipe cards for explicit starch, grain, legume and flour ingredients. Recipe quantities are used only for ingredient-level calculations. Composite sauces, liquid alternatives, unsupported ingredient states, implausible quantities and missing GI matches remain explicit blockers; no partial total is published.

additionalCarbohydrateEvidence: AFCD Release 3 was used only for chickpea flour in vada pav and pure tamarind paste in pani puri because no matching Fineli foods were found. Source: Food Standards Australia New Zealand, Australian Food Composition Database Release 3, CC BY-SA 3.0 Australia. Values with and without sugar alcohols were equal for both items. This batch also uses AFCD Release 3 items identified by source IDs in the input records where matching Fineli foods were unavailable. AFCD Release 3 Cheese, ricotta (F002488) is used for pasta alla Norma because no matching Fineli record exists. For Semper Pofiber (GTIN 7310100857200), the manufacturer specification reports 17 g available carbohydrate and 65 g fibre per 100 g, 3 g per tablespoon, and approximately 17 g per dl; this product-specific record is used only for the small recipe amount. AFCD Release 3 Vanilla bean extract (F009350) supplies the composition proxy for teaspoon quantities of vanilla extract. AFCD Release 3 is also used in this cohort for spring onion, commercial hoisin, lime juice and pure tamarind paste. Ingredient-level Fineli Rel20 sources are preserved by food IDs in the record table. The eighth batch reuses ingredient-level Fineli Rel20 and AFCD Release 3 records only from existing source calculation files. Unresolved recipe-card quantities and product matches are reported as blockers; no generic piece or product substitution is made. The ninth batch adds FSANZ AFCD Release 3 dried mung beans (F000446; CC BY-SA 3.0 Australia) where Fineli did not contain a matching dried mung-bean record. The corn-tortilla GI analogue is from a published Mexican human-food study (8 participants; bread reference) and is converted to the glucose scale with the 0.71 factor described by International Tables 2021; it is supplementary, low-confidence evidence. The tenth batch uses FSANZ AFCD Release 3 chickpea flour F003986 and dried mung beans F000446, with attribution and licence noted in their records.
